dufie.who: Dufie: an athletic slim young woman with a SHAVED head, gold choker, black sleeveless high-neck bodysuit, leopard-print wrap skirt, wrist wraps, barefoot. Weapons: two short curved sickle-shaped daggers, one in each hand.

SIGNATURE POSE: crouched very low, both curved daggers crossed in front of her face, eyes glaring right
basic: IDLE STANCE (anchor)
RIGHT CUT: explosive lunge to the right, front knee bent, back leg straight, her right arm sweeps horizontally across at chest height, arm and blade drawn as a smear with a wide white crescent arc

FOLLOW-THROUGH: low on one knee, both daggers extended out behind her, hair-free head down, momentum lines
step: DASH: body almost horizontal, launched forward to the right just above the ground, both arms trailing back, whole body drawn as a smear with long horizontal speed streaks and a black-violet shadow trail
